title: Advanced graduate data-science assignment series
summary: Graduate students complete four advanced, Kaggle-style data-science assignments with abstract high-level questions that depend on datasets, starter code, lecture algorithms, and multi-stage analysis. Researchers found that ChatGPT required substantial prompt engineering and added course context to solve these authentic tasks.

sources.title: Implications of ChatGPT for Data Science Education
sources.evidence_quote: Course 3 assignments have abstract prompts with high-level goals. Multiple steps are combined into a single large prompt

assessment.summary: Solve abstract, multi-stage data-analysis and machine-learning questions using supplied data, starter code, and algorithms taught in the course.
student_actions: Infer implementation details from course materials.
Build and evaluate data-processing and machine-learning pipelines.
Report requested metrics and model results.

outputs.artifact: Advanced data-science code and analysis responses

student_role.description: Researchers benchmarked ChatGPT-3.5 with raw and engineered prompts; student AI permission is not reported.

grading.method: Generated benchmark solutions were checked against student-facing tests and ground-truth outputs.

provenance.extraction_method: Full PDF read from pdftotext output.
